title: actor.register, contract version 1
description: Registers an actor (PRD 5.16, 6.4), the first step of a registration: the actor is created pending at version 1 and credential generation 1 with its profile, in one changeset, and runs nothing until actor.activate makes it active. The command expects the actor not to exist; an id that exists is version_conflict. An end user, a staff actor with a responsible person and a service actor without an active staff actor responsible for it are refused with validation_failed. The display name and the email are personal data, classified personal (PRD 12.2). The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Identity\Domain\Commands\RegisterActor, and the generated codec RegisterActorCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

actor.description: The id of the actor to register, made by the caller.

class.description: The actor's class, which never changes: staff for a person who logs in to the panel, service for an agent, an integration or a sidecar, which only holds service credentials. end_user is refused until the end users' connections come (B13).

display_name.description: The name the actor's profile shows, 1 to 200 characters without control characters, that starts and ends with a character that is not white space. Personal data.

email.description: The contact email address of the actor's profile, or of the person responsible for a service: a local part, an @ and a domain with a dot, at most 254 characters, without white space or control characters. It is never the key of an identity. Personal data.

responsible.description: For a service actor, the id of the active staff actor responsible for it; null, or missing, for a staff actor.
